alerted_big: magnitude detection only: alert and big, irrespective of direction or gain
false_alarm: alert on a non-big release; not necessarily a harmful forecast
directional_big_hit: alert and big and forecast deviation has the surprise direction
wrong_way_big_alert: alert and big and forecast deviation has the opposite direction
material_big_hit: alert and big and absolute-error gain >= 0.15 pp
big_precision: magnitude big hits / all alerts in the selected frame
directional_big_precision: directional big hits / all alerts in the selected frame
material_big_precision: material big hits / all alerts in the selected frame
all_release_precision: Use frame=all for all-release alert precision. Frame=big is conditional on realised large surprises and is not all-release precision.
